title: Warden bu xal bu dul fay
intro: Benn jëmm mingi taxaw ci buntu barab biñ gëna ragal ci liñu dul gis, ñu dénk ko wareef bu kenn bëggul. Su ruuh yiy dundu lu metti di yuuxu ngir ñu yërëm leen, tontu bu dëgër dafay yegg ci biir néegi safara yi. Ndax mën nga xam kan mooy gardien biy dundu ba fàww?
clues: Maa ngi taxaw ci buntu barabu yar bu raglu ci lu nëbbu.
Sama wareef bu mag mooy safara gu tàng gu dul fey.
Ruuh yiy dundu lu metti dañuy woo sama tur, di ñaan ñu muccal leen ci seen tiis budul jeex.
Bu ñu ñaanee, maa ngi leen di wax ni duñu dem, ba fàww.
Duma nit, duma jinn — man maay mbindéef bu sell déggal.
Man maay malaaka mi gëna mag biñ fal muy gardien budul jeex ci safara.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
